class.name: SimulationDomain
class.description:
[SimulationDomain] is a specialzied [Viewport]-like class designed explicitly for [i]The Conservatory[/i]. It is similar to [SubViewport] in that it has its own space, canvas, and scenario (for physics and 2D+3D rendering respectively), but it is strictly controlled by the engine and moreover does not need a container or texture to render to. Instead, one domain is selected to be "active" and will override the root viewport.
This system allows many worlds to be loaded in parallel without having to worry about which one to draw or simulate; this is handled by the engine and game together.

method.name: get_is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this instance is valid and can be used.

method.name: get_is_current
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this instance is the one currently overriding the root viewport. This is always [code]false[/code]in headless mode.

method.name: get_physics_space_2d
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the 2D physical space for this [SimulationDomain]. Physical 2D objects for this simulation should have their space set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: get_physics_space_3d
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the 3D physical space for this [SimulationDomain]. Physical 3D objects for this simulation should have their space set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: get_render_canvas
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the render canvas for this [SimulationDomain]. Rendered 2D objects for this simulation should have their canvas set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: get_render_scenario
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the render scenario for this [SimulationDomain]. Rendered 3D objects for this simulation should have their scenario set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Destroys this instance like [method Free], but validates that it is acceptable to do so. [b]DANGER:[/b] [i]Never[/i] [code]free()[/code] a [SimulationDomain], or remove it as a child from the scene tree, or call this method without first destroying the corresponding [code]WorldInstance[/code] (a class in [i]The Conservatory[/i]). Failure to follow this warning will crash the game. Note that [code]WorldInstance[/code] invokes this method itself when calling [code]SaveAndUnload()[/code].

method.name: set_conservatory_callbacks
method.description: [b]DANGER:[/b] This is strictly for internal use by [i]The Conservatory[/i]'s scene tree type, [i]The Fabric of Reality[/i]. Attempting to use this yourself will crash the game.
